purpose: Preserve routing decisions and rejected variants so future route edits do not accidentally reintroduce a known drive-cap failure.

final_decisions.decision: Frederick remains a Day 8 dinner stop, but the overnight is Gettysburg.
final_decisions.reason: The original Frederick-Gettysburg-Bethlehem Day 9 routed at 221 baseline minutes. Continuing to Gettysburg on Day 8 converts the final Day 8 drive to 118 minutes and the final Day 9 drive to 198 minutes.

final_decisions.decision: Federal Hill and AVAM are retained as rated alternatives but removed from the October 10 core schedule.
final_decisions.reason: Philadelphia-Baltimore-Washington routed at 195 baseline minutes before urban parking and traffic, leaving an unsafe margin before Snallygaster's fixed 14:00 entry. Direct Philadelphia-Washington is 186 baseline minutes.

final_decisions.decision: After Bethlehem, drive 22 baseline minutes to sleep in Easton.
final_decisions.reason: The Easton advance balances Days 9-11 without sacrificing Gettysburg or SteelStacks and makes Paterson/Southbury feasible.

final_decisions.decision: Use Paterson Great Falls as the only scheduled Day 10 attraction.
final_decisions.reason: It splits Easton-Southbury into 88- and 118-minute legs while keeping the full bed-to-bed baseline at 205 minutes.

final_decisions.decision: Sleep near I-84 in Southbury rather than Beacon, Litchfield, Danbury or central Waterbury.
final_decisions.reason: Southbury balances the last two days at 205 and 200 baseline minutes while prioritizing clean, safe two-room lodging and easy parking.

final_decisions.decision: Schedule the New England Carousel Museum and Old Sturbridge Village on October 14.
final_decisions.reason: The final drive remains 200 baseline minutes and reaches the Boston Logan hotel zone around 17:00 under the planned schedule.

rejected_variants.note: Route 1 remains US-only. Reconsider only after written visa/re-entry confirmation.

traffic_policy.routing_baseline: OSRM road-network duration without live traffic
traffic_policy.planning_ranges: Risk buffers, explicitly not traffic forecasts
traffic_policy.live_check: Recalculate in Google Maps or the production directions provider on the travel date before departure.
traffic_policy.rule: If predicted driving exceeds 210 minutes, use the day's documented fallback, leave outside the congestion window, or remove an optional stop; never silently assume faster traffic.
